guidelines.title: WHO guideline on the prevention and management of wasting and nutritional oedema (acute malnutrition) in infants and children under 5 years
guidelines.recommendation_text: WHZ or WLZ < -3 SD (or MUAC < 115 mm as an alternative measure) and/or nutritional oedema.

guidelines.title: WHO Child Growth Standards: Length/height-for-age, weight-for-age, weight-for-length, weight-for-height and body mass index-for-age: Methods and development
guidelines.recommendation_text: To fit a single model for the whole age range, 0.7 cm was therefore added to the cross-sectional height values before merging them with the longitudinal sample's length data.
